taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-02 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 31374.7 | 20.07 | 20.07
2 | 7559.9 | 12.79 | 32.86
3 | 3573.3 | 1.62 | 34.48
4 | 313.2 | 38.90 | 73.38
5 | 53.6 | 0.41 | 73.79
6 | 22.8 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-02
Curve type: Q-type (ρ1 > ρ2 > ρ3 > ρ4 > ρ5 > ρ6 — continuously descending resistivity sequence)
Aquifer depth: 73.79 m to greater depth (base of Layer 5 into Layer 6, resistivity 22.8 ohm-m)
Recommendation: Plan drilling to at least 74 m depth to intersect the low-resistivity Layer 6, interpreted as the main water-bearing zone; log lithology carefully through the thin 53.6 ohm-m transition layer (73.38–73.79 m) to confirm aquifer onset before setting screen intervals.
